literal: The cruel one's cruelty proclaims, along with the bracelets, the natural beauty faded shoulders.
translation: Along with the slipping bracelets, my shoulders, which have lost their natural beauty, proclaim the cruelty of my cruel lover.
modern: கொடியவரான காதலரின் கொடுமையை, கழலும் வளையல்களோடு சேர்ந்து, தம் இயற்கை அழகை இழந்த என் தோள்கள் பிறருக்கு அறிவிக்கின்றன.
explanation: In this verse, the heroine laments her physical decline caused by the pain of separation from her lover. Her shoulders have grown so thin that her bracelets are slipping off. She says that these wasted shoulders, having lost their natural beauty, act together with the falling bracelets to publicly announce the cruelty of her lover who left her. The physical changes in her body serve as an open testimony to his harshness.
